Fellowship overview

This Inland Norway PhD fellowship connects bioinformatics and machine learning with the diagnosis of infection and antimicrobial resistance. It is an employed doctoral research position, with the research task and formal qualification requirements set out in the employer's advert.

Research Areas

  • Bioinformatics
  • Machine learning
  • Antimicrobial resistance
